ACID_BOMB.description:
Launch a salvo of explosive bolts at the targeted position, dealing 135 physical damage in a 4.5 radius.
Creates corrosive fumes for 3.5, decreasing damage resistances by 0.14.
ACID_BOMB.name: Explosive Salvo

AFTER_IMAGE.description:
Combine up to two abilities. The combo resets after 6.

1st After Image:
Dash towards the targeted position, leaving an After Image of yourself at your original position for up to 6. Moving more than 32 away from the After Image will set this ability on cooldown.

2nd Return to Image:
Teleport to the After Image (cannot teleport through obstacles).
AFTER_IMAGE.name: After Image

AIR_RAID.description:
Leap to the targeted position and conjure a foothold in the air, becoming Untargetable for up to 3.75.
Increases your Defense vs. mobs by 9 for 3.75.

Sky Bolt:
Shoot a lightning-infused arrow at the targeted position, dealing 123 magical damage in a 4 radius to all enemies after 0.4.

The ability can be recast up to 3 times while Sky's Fury is active, firing a Sky Bolt.
After 3 Sky Bolt casts, Sky's Fury ends.
AIR_RAID.name: Sky's Fury

AMBUSH.description:
Prepare an ambush, turning yourself invisible for 7 (attacking, using an ability, or interacting with an object will reveal you).
Increases your damage by 0.05 for every 1 you stay invisible (stacks up to 6 times) the next time you deal damage within 4 after revealing you.

If you move more than 13 away from the cast location you will be revealed.
AMBUSH.name: Ambush

ARCANECORRIDOR.description:
Create a $spelleffectarea.rectangle.height_start$ long corridor of altered time in the targeted direction, lasting for 8.
Increases Move Speed by 0.6 and Auto-Attack Speed by 0.6 for all allies in the corridor.

Slows all enemies in the corridor by 0.3.
ARCANECORRIDOR.name: Time Corridor

ARCANEORB2.description:
Shoot a sphere of arcane energy in the targeted direction, dealing 73.01 magical damage in a 6 radius upon impact with an enemy.
Purges all buffs on enemies hit (except for healing over time effects).
Silences enemies for 1.68 (vs players) / 3.36 (vs mobs).
ARCANEORB2.name: Arcane Orb

ARCANE_CHAIN_MISSILE.description:
Shoot a Chain Missile in the targeted direction, dealing 132 magical damage to the first enemy hit.
Upon hitting an enemy, it will jump to the closest enemy within 7 of the last enemy hit, dealing 132 magical damage to all following enemies (can hit up to 3 targets; can't hit the same target multiple times).
Applies one Arcane Charge to all enemies hit.

Arcane Charges are consumed whenever you deal direct damage to the affected target, dealing an additional 60 magical damage (Chain Missile damage does not count as direct damage).
ARCANE_CHAIN_MISSILE.name: Chain Missile

ARCANE_METEOR.description:
Call down a dark sphere, impacting after 0.4.
Deals 112 magical damage to all enemies in a 5 radius. 
Applies a Dark Aura on up to 3 enemies hit.

Each Dark Aura has a 5 radius around the affected enemy lasting for 5.
Decreases healing received by 0.15 and all damage dealt by 0.15 (vs players) / by 0.15 (vs mobs) within the aura.
Slows by 0.15 (all effects stack up to 3 times).
ARCANE_METEOR.name: Dark Sphere

AREAOFDECAY.description:
Create an Area of Decay with a $channeling.spelleffectarea.circle.radius_start$ radius, applying Vile Curse charges every 0.8, while channeling for $channeling.totalduration$.
Purges healing over time effects from all enemies in the area.

Each Vile Curse Charge deals $$CURSEDOT_EFFECT.attributechangeovertime.totalchange$ magical damage over $$CURSEDOT_EFFECT.attributechangeovertime.time$ (stacks up to 4 times).
AREAOFDECAY.name: Area of Decay

ARMORCHAIN.description:
Latch a chain onto the targeted enemy, dealing 61.43 magical damage.
Targets that stay within a 30 radius around you for 2.1 will be pulled toward you.

Once pulled, an enemy becomes immune to another Soul Chain for 10.
ARMORCHAIN.name: Soul Chain

ARMORPIERCER.description:
Release a demonic beam in the targeted direction, dealing 110 magical damage to all enemies hit.
Reduces damage resistances by 0.17 for 4.
ARMORPIERCER.name: Armor Piercer

ARMOR_CD_RESET.description:
Gain a Flash of Insight, resetting the cooldown of your armor ability.
If the cast is interrupted the cooldown will be halved.
ARMOR_CD_RESET.name: Flash of Insight

ARMOR_WEB.description:
Place a web with a $spelleffectarea.circle.radius_max$ radius under your feet, lasting 5 (can't be interrupted).
Slows all enemies within it by 0.35.
Purges all Move Speed buffs.

Placing a new web on the ground will dissolve all ally webs in a 16 radius around you.
ARMOR_WEB.name: Mythical Web

ARROWRAIN.description:
Fire volleys of arrows in the air every 0.5, each landing at the targeted position after 0.5, while channeling for $channeling.totalduration$.
Each volley deals 99 physical damage to all enemies within a 5 radius.
Slows by 0.2 for 2.
ARROWRAIN.name: Rain of Arrows

ARTILLERY_COMMAND.description:
Call in Ballista Support Fire at the targeted position, stunning all enemies within a 3 radius for 2.2 on impact after 0.6.
Deals 61.12 physical damage.
ARTILLERY_COMMAND.name: Ballista Support Fire

ASSASSINSPIRIT.description:
Invoke your Assassin Spirit, applying an Assassin Spirit Charge on you every 2.

Decreases your Defense by 0.04.

The ability can last up to 15 but can be deactivated earlier.

Each Assassin Spirit Charge increases all your damage by 0.06 for 8 (stacks up to 3 times).
ASSASSINSPIRIT.name: Assassin Spirit

ASSASSIN_DASH.description: Dash behind the target enemy and deal 90 physical damage.
ASSASSIN_DASH.name: Swift Cut

AUTOFIRE2.description:
Focus your attacks on the targeted enemy, dealing 32 physical damage every 0.3 while channeling for up to $channeling.totalduration$.
The last attack explodes, dealing 82 magical damage to all enemies in a 5 radius.
AUTOFIRE2.name: Auto Fire

AVALON_BEAM.description:
Emit a beam of Avalonian Energy along a {0} long line, dealing 80 magical damage.
Interrupts enemies' spell casting.
Shocks all enemies hit, dealing {2} magical damage over {3}.
AVALON_BEAM.name: Avalonian Beam

AXEBOOST.description:
Release an Adrenaline Boost, increasing all your damage by 0.25, your Move Speed by 0.4 and your Auto-Attack Speed by 0.4 for up to 9.

If you deal no direct damage for 3.5, the Adrenaline Boost will end early.
AXEBOOST.name: Adrenaline Boost

AXESMASH.description:
Strike the targeted enemy, dealing 152 physical damage.
Decreases damage resistances by 0.16 for 8.
AXESMASH.name: Deadly Chop

AXETHROW.description:
Combine up to two abilities. The combo resets after 9.

1st Blood Draw:
Throw an axe in the targeted direction, dealing physical damage to all enemies hit, based on the number of Rending Bleed Charges on them.

2nd Blood Bandit:
Throw an axe infused with blood magic in the targeted direction, dealing 110 physical damage 
Heals you based on the number of Rending Bleed Charges on the first enemy hit.

[#] Rending Bleed Charges: 0 | $$AXETHROW_EFFECT.directattributechange.valueoverride.ifcharge.mincharges$ | $$AXETHROW_EFFECT.directattributechange.valueoverride.ifcharge.mincharges$ | $$AXETHROW_EFFECT.directattributechange.valueoverride.ifcharge.mincharges$
[#] Damage: 160 | $$AXETHROW_EFFECT.d
AXETHROW.name: Blood Bandit

AXEWHIRLWIND2.description:
Spin around like a whirlwind, swinging your axe and dealing 56 physical damage every 0.5 in a 5 radius while channeling for up to {3} (can move while channeling and can't be interrupted).

Hitting at least one enemy increases your Movement Speed by 0.2 for 0.75. 
Each consecutive hit on the same enemy increases the damage by {6}.
 
Each 0.5 spent channeling costs 4 Energy.
AXEWHIRLWIND2.name: Whirlwind

AXE_CHARGE.description:
Charge toward the targeted position, decreasing Healing Received of all enemies in a 5 radius by 0.2 for 3.
Increases Healing Received of up to $$AXE_CHARGE_CONDITION.applyspell.maxeffectareatargets$ allies in a 5 radius by 0.2 for 4.
AXE_CHARGE.name: Battle Rush

BACKHAND_KNOCKBACK.description:
Strike in the targeted direction, knocking all enemies hit 9 back.
Deals 65 physical damage.

Knocked-back enemies that collide with the environment receive an additional 100 physical damage. 
Damage resistances will be decreased by 0.2 for 5.
BACKHAND_KNOCKBACK.name: Backhand Strike

BACK_SLASH.description:
Swing your daggers in a cone in front of you while leaping backwards 8.
Deals physical damage based on the number of Assassin Spirit Charges on you or Sunder Armor Charges on the target.

[#] Charges: 0 | 1 | 2 | 3
[#] Damage: 75 | 120 | 180 | 238

Consumes all applied Assassin Spirit Charges or Sunder Armor Charges.
BACK_SLASH.name: Merciless Finish

BATTLEFRENZY.description:
Enter a Battle Frenzy, increasing your Move Speed by 0.55 for 5.
Grants immunity to Stuns, Roots, and Slows.
Cleanses all Crowd Control effects from you (except Stuns).
BATTLEFRENZY.name: Battle Frenzy

BEARTRAP.description:
Place a trap with a $spelleffectarea.circle.radius_max$ radius under your feet, lasting 12.5.
The first enemy stepping on the trap will start to bleed, taking $$BEARTRAP_EFFECT.attributechangeovertime.totalchange$ physical damage over $$BEARTRAP_EFFECT.attributechangeovertime.totalduration$.
Slows by 0.9.

If the enemy is a Hide Mob, it will have its damage resistances reduced by 0.55 for 8.
BEARTRAP.name: Bear Trap

BERSERK_SPRINT.description:
Motivate yourself with vengeance, applying two Vengeance Charges on you.
Apply one additional Vengeance Charge for every 0.2 Health you are missing.

Each Vengeance Charge increases your Move Speed by 0.05 and your damage by 0.05 for 5 (stacks up to 5 times).
BERSERK_SPRINT.name: Vengeful Sprint

BLACKHOLE.description:
Create a black hole with a {0} radius at the targeted position.
After {1}, the black hole pulls all enemies within its radius towards its center.
Deals 161.15 magical damage.
Slows by 0.16 for 5.
BLACKHOLE.name: Black Hole

BLADE_AREA.description:
Slam your blades into the ground, unleashing magic waves in a 8.5 radius (cannot be interrupted).
Decreases max and current Health of all enemies hit by 0.1 for 7.
Deals magical damage based on the amount of Heroic Charges on you.

[#] Heroic Charges: 0 | 1 | 2 | 3
[#] Damage: 95 | 152 | 226 | 320

Consumes all your Heroic Charges.
BLADE_AREA.name: Soulless Stream

BLADE_AURA.description:
Create two magic blades that circle within a 5 radius around you for 3.
The blades deal 22 magical damage every 0.5.
Increases all your damage by 0.04 per enemy hit (stacks up to 10 times) for 3.
BLADE_AURA.name: Raging Blades

BLAZING_GEYSER.description:
Hit the ground, releasing a Blazing Geyser with a $spelleffectarea.circle.radius_start$ radius in front of you.
Deals 188 magical damage.
Throws all enemies hit in the air for $$BLAZING_GEYSER_KNOCKBACK.knockback.duration$.

Hitting at least one enemy will reset the cooldown of your first-slot ability.
BLAZING_GEYSER.name: Blazing Geyser

BLESSED_MACES.description:
Conjure a $spelleffectarea.rectangle.width_max$ wide blessed aurora lasting 3.
Increases Move Speed for up to 20 allies passing through the aurora by 0.3 for 5.
Applies a shield that absorbs up to 400 damage (before resistances) while Move Speed is increased.

Bless your maces, restoring 30 Health for you and up to 10 allies in a 8 radius around you with every Auto-Attack within the next 5.
BLESSED_MACES.name: Blessed Aurora

BLINDSPOT.description:
Enter the Blind Spot of your enemy, turning yourself invisible to players and increasing your Move Speed by 0.6 for 1.5.

Deals 90 bonus magical damage the next time you deal damage within 3.
BLINDSPOT.name: Blind Spot

BLINK.description:
Teleport to the targeted position (can't teleport through obstacles).
Grants immunity to damage and purges for 0.2.
BLINK.name: Blink

BLOCK.description: Block incoming attacks, becoming immune to damage and all Crowd Control effects while channeling for $channeling.totalduration$ (can move while channeling).
BLOCK.name: Block

BLOODLUST.description: Give in to your Bloodlust, restoring 50 Health whenever you deal direct damage within the next 6 (only applies up to 7 times).
BLOODLUST.name: Bloodlust

BLOODTHIRSTYBLADE.description:
Give in to your Bloodthirsty Blade, dealing an additional 50 magical damage (vs. players) / 50 magical damage (vs. mobs) with each Auto-Attack.
Steals 1 of the Health the enemy has lost through the bonus damage.
Increases your Move Speed by 0.3.

Deals 0.04 of your Max Health as true damage to yourself every 1.

The ability lasts up to 6 but can be deactivated earlier.
BLOODTHIRSTYBLADE.name: Bloodthirsty Blade

BLOOD_BLADE.description:
Infuse your blade with blood magic and swing it in a cone in the targeted direction, dealing 130 magical damage.

The ability can be recast within 3 up to 3 times, increasing its cooldown by 5 per cast.

After the third cast take $$BLOOD_BLADE_DOT.attributechangeovertime.totalchange$ of your Max Health as true damage over $$BLOOD_BLADE_DOT.attributechangeovertime.time$.
BLOOD_BLADE.name: Blood Ritual

BOLTSHOT.description: Fire an explosive bolt at the targeted position, dealing 130 magical damage to all enemies in a 3 radius.
BOLTSHOT.name: Explosive Bolt

BOULDER_TOSS.description:
Throw a boulder towards the targeted area, which bounces three times as it rolls. Each impact will reduce in damage and radius.

[#] Boulder Bounces: 1st | 2nd | 3rd
[#] Radius: {0} | {1} | {2}
[#] Damage: 177 | 126 | 76

Each impact also sets all enemies hit on fire, dealing {6} magical damage over {7}.
Reduces Healing Received by 0.2 (stacks up to 3 times).
BOULDER_TOSS.name: Infernal Boulder

BRAMBLESEED.description:
Throw seeds along a $spelleffectarea.rectangle.height_max$ long line in targeted direction, dealing 54 magical damage. 

After a 0.7s delay brambles will grow along the line, dealing 162 magical damage.
Throws all enemies hit in the air for $$BRAMBLESEED_DELAYED_HIT.knockback.duration$.
BRAMBLESEED.name: Brambleseed

BRIEROFLIFE.description:
Protect the targeted ally with Living Armor, restoring 66 Health and increasing their damage resistances by 0.13 for 4.
Whenever the target receives direct damage, they will restore 40 Health.
BRIEROFLIFE.name: Living Armor

BURNAURA.description:
Ignite yourself, dealing 0.02 true damage (vs. players) / 0.02 magical damage (vs. mobs / mounts) every 0.5 to up to 5 enemies within a 7 radius around you.

Take 0.02 of your Max Health every 0.5 as true damage.
Decreases your Healing Received by 0.5.

The ability can last up to 20 but can be deactivated earlier.
BURNAURA.name: Self Ignition

BURNINGARROWS.description:
Enchant your next 10 arrows for the next 15, causing them to explode on impact.
Each explosion deals 23 magical damage to all enemies in a 5 radius around the targeted enemy (also works for arrows from spells).
BURNINGARROWS.name: Explosive Arrows

CALTROPS.description:
Shoot a trap with a $spelleffectarea.circle.radius_start$ radius into the ground at the targeted position, lasting 12.
The first enemy to step on the trap will activate it, slowing all enemies within a 3 radius by 0.3 for 3.
Deals 34 physical damage.
If the trap activates, your Move Speed is increased by 0.3 for 3.
CALTROPS.name: Caltrops

CARTWHEEL.description:
Dash towards the targeted position, knocking back all enemies you pass through by 3.
Deals 66.69 physical damage.

If you take damage while dashing, your damage resistances will be increased by 0.2 for 3.
CARTWHEEL.name: Cartwheel

CASTBUBBLE.description:
Surround yourself in a bubble of energy with a 3 radius for 5.
Enemies touching the bubble will get knocked back by 12.
Deals 25 magical damage.
Grants you immunity against Forced Movement effects.
CASTBUBBLE.name: Energy Emission

CC_BLOCK.description:
Ready yourself, increasing your Move Speed by 0.45 and becoming immune to Forced Movement effects for 3.

If you are Stunned, Rooted, or Slowed, this effect will be replaced, cleansing all Crowd Control effects and increasing your Move Speed by 1.2 for 4.
Grants immunity to Stuns, Roots, Slows, and Transformations.
CC_BLOCK.name: Premonition

CC_IMMUNITY.description:
Motivate yourself, cleansing all Crowd Control effects on you.
Grants immunity to stuns, roots, slows, and silences for 6.

Decreases all damage you deal by 0.5 for 6.
CC_IMMUNITY.name: Motivating Worker's Song

CELESTIAL_SPHERE.description:
Conjure a bouncing Celestial Sphere at the targeted ally, restoring 77 health for up to 10 allies in a 4 radius.
Bounces to the closest ally within a 11 radius of the last ally hit (can hit up to 8 targets; can hit the same target multiple times, but not twice in a row).
CELESTIAL_SPHERE.name: Celestial Sphere

CHAINDASH.description:
Charge towards the targeted enemy, hitting the target and then charging to the closest enemy within 7 of the enemy you hit last (up to 3 different targets), dealing more physical damage with each consecutive hit.
Turns you invisible and grants immunity to damage while charging.

[#] Enemy Hit: 1 | 2 | 3
[#] Damage: 110 | {3} | {4}
CHAINDASH.name: Chain Slash

CHANNELED_RUN.description:
Focus on running, increasing Move Speed by 0.7 while channeling for $channeling.totalduration$.
Grants immunity to Stuns, Roots and Slows.
Restores 4 Energy every 0.5.
CHANNELED_RUN.name: Focused Run

CHARGESLOWAE.description:
Dash towards the targeted position, dealing 56.41 physical damage to all enemies you pass through.
Slows by 0.5 for 4.
CHARGESLOWAE.name: Slowing Charge

CHARGE_IN.description:
Dash toward the targeted position (can't be interrupted), knocking all enemies you pass through 15 in the charge direction.
Deals 60 physical damage.

Knocked-back enemies that collide with the environment will be stunned for $$CHARGE_IN_COLLISION.stun.time.
CHARGE_IN.name: Crush Charge

CHARGE_ROOT.description:
Leap towards the targeted position, dealing 53.18 physical damage to all enemies in a 6 radius on impact.
Roots all enemies hit for 2.56 (vs players) / 5.11 (vs mobs).
Interrupts enemies' spell casting.
CHARGE_ROOT.name: Snare Charge

CHARGE_SHIELD.description:
Charge towards the target.
Applies a shield on you, absorbing up to 250 damage (before resistances) for 3, upon arrival at the target.

If the target is an ally, the shield is also applied to the target.
CHARGE_SHIELD.name: Shield Charge

CHARGINGBLADE.description:
Combine up to two abilities. The combo resets after 6.

1st Inner Focus:
Gather your inner focus every 0.2, increasing your damage and Move Speed by 0.08 (stacks up to 5 times) for up to 6.
Channeling for {1} enables the next combo ability.

2nd Release:
Your Move Speed is increased by 0.3 and you become immune to Stuns, Roots and Slows for 2.
Removes any remaining Inner Focus after 2.
CHARGINGBLADE.name: Inner Focus

CIRCLEOFLIFE.description:
Mend the wounds of up to 15 allies within a 11 radius around you, restoring their Health based on their number of Rejuvenation Charges.

[#] Rejuvenation Charges: 0 | 1 | 2 | 3
[#] Health: 107 | 107 | 107 | 107

Any enemies hit with $applyspell.IfSpellActive.atleastcharges$ or more Thorn Charges active on them, will be rooted for 2.
Deals 112 magical damage.
CIRCLEOFLIFE.name: Circle of Life

CLAYMORECHARGE.description:
Charge towards the targeted enemy, becoming immune to all Crowd Control effects, Debuffs, and damage for 1.
Enemies who are unmounted will be stunned for 0.8 on impact (ignoring crowd control resistance).
Deals physical damage to the targeted enemy, and all enemies you pass through based on the amount of Heroic Charges on you.

[#] Heroic Charges: 0 | 1 | 2 | 3
[#] Target Damage: 85 | 137 | 204 | 290
[#] Pass Through Damage: 56 | 90 | 135 | 191

Consumes all your Heroic Charges.
CLAYMORECHARGE.name: Charge

CLAYMORESLASH.description:
Dash towards the targeted position, dealing 135 physical damage to all enemies you pass through.
Decreases their damage resistances for 6 based on the amount of Heroic Charges on you. 

[#] Heroic Charges: 0 | 1 | 2 | 3 
[#] Resistance Reduction: 0.05 | 0.1 | 0.15 | 0.2

Consumes all your Heroic Charges.
CLAYMORESLASH.name: Fearless Strike

CLEANSEHEAL.description:
Revitalize up to $applyspell.maxeffectareatargets$ allies in a 4 radius of the targeted position, healing them based on the number of Rejuvenation Charges on them.
Cleanses all Crowd Control effects and debuffs (except damage over time effects; can be used while stunned or silenced).
 
[#] Rejuvenation Charges: 0 | $$CLEANSEHEAL_HEAL.directattributechange.valueoverride.ifcharge.mincharges$ | $$CLEANSEHEAL_HEAL.directattributechange.valueoverride.ifcharge.mincharges$ | $$CLEANSEHEAL_HEAL.directattributechange.valueoverride.ifcharge.mincharges$
[#] Heal: 65 | $$CLEANSEHEAL_HEAL.directattributechange.valueoverride.ifcharge.value$ | $$CLEANSEHEAL_HEAL.directattributechange.valueoverride.ifcharge
CLEANSEHEAL.name: Cleanse Heal

CLEANSESPEED2.description:
Purify up to 10 allies in a 4 radius, cleansing all Crowd Control effects and debuffs (except damage over time effects; can be used while stunned or silenced).
Increases the cleansed allies' Move Speed by 0.4 for 3.
CLEANSESPEED2.name: Motivating Cleanse

CLEANSE_DASH.description:
Dash towards the targeted position.
Removes all Crowd Control Effects (can be used while stunned or silenced).
CLEANSE_DASH.name: Break Free

CLEAVE.description:
Swing your sword in a 6 radius around you, dealing 60.63 physical damage. 
Hitting at least one enemy increases your Movement Speed by 0.2 for 5.
Applies Heroic Charges on you based on the amount of enemies hit 

[#] Hits: 0 | 1 | 2 | 3
[#] Heroic Charges: 0 | 1 | 1 | 2

Each Heroic Charge increases your Auto-Attack Speed by 0.12 for 6 (stacks up to 3 times).
CLEAVE.name: Heroic Cleave

COMBATSTAFF_SLASH.description:
Throw a demonic version of your weapon at the targeted position, which lands and spins in a {0} radius for 3.
Deals {2} physical damage over 3.
Breaks any active damage shields on all enemies hit and prevents new damage shields from being applied.
Reduces all damage they deal by 0.4 (vs players) / 0.1 (vs mobs) every 1.25 (stacks up to 3 times).
The debuff lasts for 5 after leaving the radius.
COMBATSTAFF_SLASH.name: Fatal Blade

CONCUSSIVEBLOW_MULTI_1.description:
Combine up to two abilities. The combo resets after 6.

1st and 2nd: Flowing Blow
Land a Flowing Blow on the targeted enemy, dealing 85 physical damage in a cone in front of you.
Increases your threat towards all mobs hit by 50.

3rd: Concussive Blow
Land an overhead Concussive Blow on the targeted enemy, dealing 85 physical damage  in a 4 radius.
Stuns the target for 1.43.
Increases your threat towards all mobs hit by 50.
CONCUSSIVEBLOW_MULTI_1.name: Concussive Combo

CONEPUNCH2.description:
Dash to a targeted enemy, releasing a Pulse of raw energy, dealing 43 magical damage.
Decreases Max and Current Health by 0.03 for 5 (stacks up to 5 times).
Gain 3 Pulse Charges for the next 3.

Pulse Charges release an additional Pulse with each Weapon ability or Auto-Attack.

The ability can be recast within 5, increasing its cooldown by 30 (elapsed time before recasting is refunded).
CONEPUNCH2.name: Unstoppable Rush

CREATE_OPENING.description:
Combine up to two abilities. The combo resets after 1.25.

1st Create Opening:
Attack the targeted enemy, dealing 80 physical damage.

2nd Exploit Opening:
Deals 80 physical damage.
Decreases damage resistances of the target by 0.12 for 3.
CREATE_OPENING.name: Create Opening

CROSSBOW_ARMORPIERCER.description:
Fire a shredding bolt in the targeted direction, piercing through all enemies.
Deals 225 physical damage to all enemies hit.
Interrupts enemy spell casting.
CROSSBOW_ARMORPIERCER.name: Sweeping Bolt

CROSSBOW_CONE_ULTIMATE.description:
Release a volley of bolts in a cone in front of you every 1 while channeling for {1}.
Increase your Defense by 0.5.
Each volley deals 105 magical damage.
Enemy players hit will take 0.03 of their Current Health as true damage.
CROSSBOW_CONE_ULTIMATE.name: Vicious Barrage

CROSSBOW_DIVINE_SHOT.description:
Unleash a $channeling.spelleffectarea.rectangle.height_start$ long beam of Avalonian energy in the targeted direction, piercing through all enemies while channeling for $channeling.totalduration$ (can't be interrupted).
Deals 106 magical damage (vs players) / 106 magical damage (vs mobs) every 0.3.
The beam slowly follows the cursor position.
CROSSBOW_DIVINE_SHOT.name: Divine Engine

CROSSSTEP_ROUNDHOUSE.description:
Combine up to two abilities. The combo resets after 2.

1st Roundhouse Kick:
Kick all enemies in a cone in the targeted direction, dealing 78 physical damage.

2nd Cross Step:
Dash towards the targeted position, increasing your damage resistances by 0.2 while dashing.
Increases your Auto-Attack Damage by 1.25 for 5.
CROSSSTEP_ROUNDHOUSE.name: Fleet Footwork

CRYSTALWAVE.description:
Smash the ground in front of you, opening a vein of charged magical energy.

Allies in the area gain a Shield, absorbing up to 350 damage (before resistances) for up to {1}.

Deals 90 Magical Damage to enemies.
Applies one Static stack for 6.
Enemies gain one additional Static stack whenever they receive direct damage.
Stuns enemies with 5 Static stacks for 3.2.
CRYSTALWAVE.name: Hyperstatic

CRYSTALXBOW.description:
Dash to the targeted position, unleashing a barrage of energy bolts in a 8 radius around you.
Deals 81 physical damage.
Gain 0.35 damage resistances while dashing.

The ability can be recast within 5 up to 3 times, increasing its cooldown by 10 per cast.
CRYSTALXBOW.name: Flickershots

CRYSTAL_DAGGER_BLADE_RING.description:
Combine up to two abilities. The combo resets after 6 (elapsed time before recasting is refunded).

1st Ring of Death: 
Throw six daggers in a 7 radius around you, piercing through all enemies and dealing 47 physical damage. 
The daggers form a ring that deals 27 physical damage every 0.5, lasting {4}.
Increases your Move Speed by 0.4 for up to 2.

2nd Recall Daggers: 
Recall all daggers to your current position. 
Each dagger can pierce a maximum of {5} targets. 
Deal physical damage depending on the total amount of daggers that hit a target.

[#] Amount of Daggers: 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6
[#] Damage: 55 | 110 | 165 | 220 | 275 | 330
CRYSTAL_DAGGER_BLADE_RING.name: Ring of Death

CRYSTAL_SCYTHE_DASH_ZONE.description:
Dash in the targeted direction, dealing 105 physical damage (vs players) / 86 physical damage (vs mobs) to all enemies you pass through.
Conjure an area with a {2} radius around you after dashing, lasting 12.
While inside the area, hitting at least one enemy will reduce the cooldown of your weapon abilities by 0.33.

The ability can be recast every 3 while the ability is active.
CRYSTAL_SCYTHE_DASH_ZONE.name: Relentless Assault

CURSEBLADE.description:
Shoot a Cursed Sickle in the targeted direction, piercing through all enemies. The sickle returns to the cast position after it reaches the full cast range, applying all its effects again.

Deals 21.98 magical damage to all enemies in it every 1 (this damage cannot be reflected).
Slows by 0.5 (ignores Crowd Control Resistance).
Slows enemies in the center {5} by an additional 0.3 (ignores Crowd Control Resistance).
GLACIALFIELD.name: Frozen Hell

GLASS_MOVESPEED.description:
Disregard the threats around you, increasing your Move Speed by 0.75 and all damage by 0.75.

Decreases your Defense by 0.75.

The ability can last up to 7 but can be deactivated earlier.
GLASS_MOVESPEED.name: Defenseless Rush

GROUNDARROW.description:
Fire an arrow into the sky, which lands after 0.6 at the targeted position.
Roots all enemies in a 3 radius for 1.8.
Deals 164 magical damage.
GROUNDARROW.name: Ray of Light

GROUNDBREAKER2.description:
Split the earth in a 20 long line in front of you, dealing 46 physical damage to all enemies hit.
Enemies at the center of the split earth will be stunned for 2.7.
GROUNDBREAKER2.name: Groundbreaker

GROUNDDASH.description:
Dash towards the targeted position.
Increases all damage you deal by 0.15 for 4.
GROUNDDASH.name: Dash

GROUNDMINE.description:
Plant a mine with a $spelleffectarea.circle.radius_max$ radius at the targeted position, lasting 2.
The first player to step on the mine will activate it, dealing 270 magical damage to all enemies in a 7 radius (the damage can't be reflected).
GROUNDMINE.name: Explosive Mine

GROUNDSHAKER.description:
Hit the ground in a 4 radius around the targeted position, dealing 219 physical damage.
Throws all enemies hit into the air for $$GROUNDSHAKER_KNOCKBACK.knockback.duration$.
GROUNDSHAKER.name: Ground Shaker

GROUNDSPEAR.description:
Summon a giant spear that emerges from the ground after 0.3.
Deals 155 physical damage to all enemies within a 2.5 radius.
Slows by 0.5 for 3.
GROUNDSPEAR.name: Impaler

GROWING_PUNCH.description:
Charge up the Earth Crusher, slowing yourself by 0.25 while channeling for up to $channeling.totalduration$ (can't be interrupted).

Deals magical damage to all enemies in an area around you.
The damage and radius is based on how long you have channeled (this damage cannot be reflected; you may end the channel early).

[#] Charge Up Time: 0.5s | 1s | 1.5s | 2s
[#] Damage: 165 | 165 | 165 | 165
[#] Radius: 5 | 5 | 5 | 5

Channeling for the full duration will throw all enemies hit in the air for $$GROWING_PUNCH_KNOCKBACK.knockback.duration$.
GROWING_PUNCH.name: Earth Crusher

GROWING_RAGE.description:
Enter a Growing Rage, building over $pulsingspell.time$.
Increases all your damage by 0.05 for every 1 (stacks up to 6 times).

Dealing damage will stop the stacking of the buff.
The buff lasts for 5 after the stacking stops.
GROWING_RAGE.name: Growing Rage

GUARDRUNE.description:
Conjure a Guard Rune with a $spelleffectarea.circle.radius_start$ radius around the targeted position, which lasts 5.
Increases the damage resistances of up to 10 allies within it by 0.06 and makes them immune to Forced Movement effects and Stuns.
GUARDRUNE.name: Guard Rune

HAIL_MULTI_1.description:
Conjure a wave of hail with a $spelleffectarea.circle.radius_start$ radius around the targeted position, which crashes down after 0.4.
Deals 160 magical damage.
Slows by 0.1 for 2.

The spell can be recast within 3.
HAIL_MULTI_1.name: Hail

HALBERDSMASH.description:
Swing your pike at the targeted enemy, rooting them for 2.79.
Deals physical damage based on the amount of Spirit Spear Charges on you.

[#] Spirit Spear Charges: 0 | 1 | 2 | 3
[#] Damage: 69.37 | 69.37 | 69.37 | 69.37
HALBERDSMASH.name: Rooting Smash

HAMMERTACKLE.description:
Dash toward the targeted position, knocking back all enemies you pass through by 2 and stunning them for 2.35.
Deals 73.01 physical damage.

Each enemy player hit reduces this ability's cooldown by {3} (up to {4} times).
HAMMERTACKLE.name: Tackle

HAMMERWHIRLWIND2.description:
Shatter the earth in a 5.5 radius around you, dealing 66.6 physical damage to all enemies hit.
Stuns for 2.25.
Makes you the highest-priority target for all mobs hit.
HAMMERWHIRLWIND2.name: Earth Shatter

HAMMER_SHOVE.description:
Step in the targeted direction and swing your hammer in a cone in front of you, dealing 147 physical damage to all enemies hit.
Knocks back up to 10 enemy mobs  by {2}.
Increases your threat towards all mobs hit by 66.
HAMMER_SHOVE.name: Powerful Swing

HAMMER_TREMOR.description:
Smash your hammer repeatedly into the ground at the target position, dealing physical damage, while channeling for {0}.
The damage and radius is based on how long you have channeled.

[#] Channel Time: 0.4 | 0.8 | {0}
[#] Damage: 88 | 88 | 185
[#] Radius: 3 | 3 | 5
HAMMER_TREMOR.name: Seismic Tremor

HAMSTRINGSWORD.description:
Combine up to two abilities. The combo resets after 4.

1st Hamstring:
Attack the targeted enemy, dealing 86 physical damage.
Slows by 0.25 for 4.

2nd Heroic Leap:
Leap towards the targeted position, dealing 122 physical damage in a 3 radius.
HAMSTRINGSWORD.name: Hamstring

HASTE.description: Hasten your attacks, increasing your Auto-Attack Speed by 0.2 and all damage you deal by 0.2 for 8.
HASTE.name: Haste

HAWK_SHOT_MULTI1.description:
Release a Lucent Hawk in the targeted direction, piercing through all enemies and dealing 178 magical damage to each enemy hit.

The ability can be recast again within 3 up to 4 times.
HAWK_SHOT_MULTI1.name: Lucent Hawk

HEALINGBEAM.description:
Focus a Holy Beam at the targeted ally, slowing yourself by 0.3 while channeling for $channeling.totalduration$ (can't be cast on self).
Restores 50 Health every 0.5.
The healing increases by $$HEALINGBEAM_EFFECT.directattributechange.valueoverride.ifcharge.value$ every 0.5 (stacks up to 7 times).
HEALINGBEAM.name: Holy Beam

HELL_ARROW.description:
Shoot an arrow infused with demonic power in the targeted direction, piercing through all enemies.
Deals physical damage to enemy players based on the number of enemies the arrow has already hit (the damage can't be reflected).
Deals 391 physical damage to enemy mobs.

[#] Enemies Hit: 1st | 2nd | 3rd | 4th or more
[#] Damage: 189 | {2} | {3} | {4}
HELL_ARROW.name: Demon Arrow

HELMET_FIREBREATH.description: Breathe fire in a cone in front of you, dealing $$HELMET_FIREBREATH_EFFECT.attributechangeovertime.totalchange$ magical damage over $$HELMET_FIREBREATH_EFFECT.attributechangeovertime.time$ to all enemies hit.
HELMET_FIREBREATH.name: Firebreath

HEROICSTRIKE2.description:
Dash to the targeted enemy, dealing 77.81 physical damage.
Increases Movement Speed by 0.2 for 3.5.
Applies one Heroic Charge to you.

Each Heroic Charge increases your Auto-Attack Speed by 0.12 for 6 (stacks up to 3 times).
HEROICSTRIKE2.name: Heroic Strike

HOLYDESPERATEPRAYER2.description:
Cast a Desperate Prayer on the targeted ally, healing the target based on their current Health.

[#] Current Health: above 0.4 | below 0.4
[#] Healing: 100 | 220

If the current Health of your target is above 0.4, your Healing Cast is increased by 0.05 for 15 (stacks up to 3 times).
HOLYDESPERATEPRAYER2.name: Desperate Prayer

HOLYEXPLOSION.description:
Release a Holy Explosion in a 7 radius around you, knocking back all enemies hit by 10 (ignoring Crowd Control Resistance).
Heals up to 10 allies for 50 Health every 0.5, while channeling for up to {5}.
Increases the damage resistances of allies hit by the first tick by 0.16 for 3.

Each 0.5 channeling costs 4 Energy.
HOLYEXPLOSION.name: Holy Explosion

HOLYFLASH.description: Conjure a Holy Flash at the targeted position, restoring 117 Health for up to 10 allies in a 5 radius.
HOLYFLASH.name: Holy Flash

HOLYHOT.description:
Bless the targeted ally, increasing the ally's Armor by 0.3 and Healing Received by 0.3 for 4.
Grants immunity to Forced Movement effects.
HOLYHOT.name: Holy Blessing

HOLYORB.description:
Fire a Holy Orb in the targeted direction, which explodes on impact with an ally.
Restores 135 Health for up to 10 allies in a 7 radius.
HOLYORB.name: Holy Orb

HOLYSHIELD.description:
Combine up to two abilities. The combo resets after 4.

1st Divine Protection:
Give the targeted ally a shield, absorbing up to 456.3 damage (before resistances) for 4.
As long as the shield remains unbroken, you can cast Divinity's Grace.

2nd Divinity's Grace:
Detonate the shield, releasing a healing pulse that restores 160 Health for up to 10 allies in a 5 radius around the target.
HOLYSHIELD.name: Divine Protection

HOLYTOUCH.description:
Cover the targeted ally in divine light, healing them for 55 Health every 0.5, while channeling for up to {2} (can be used while stunned or silenced).
Cleanses all Crowd Control effects and debuffs (except damage over time effects).
Grants other allies immunity to all Crowd Control effects.
Increases all damage the targeted ally deals by 0.15.
HOLYTOUCH.name: Holy Touch

HOLY_DISPEL.description:
Sanctify an area at the targeted position, restoring 138 health for up to 20 allies in a 5 radius.
Increases the max and current health of all healed allies by 0.2 for 3. 
Removes enemy-placed ground-based areas (does not affect areas that exclusively buff or heal).
HOLY_DISPEL.name: Sanctify

HOLY_ULTIMATE.description:
Create a circle of Salvation with a 5.5 radius around the targeted position, charging up for 2.
Once it is charged, it heals up to 20 allies for 270 Health and makes them immune to further damage for 2.
Cleanses all Crowd Control, debuffs, and damage over time effects.
HOLY_ULTIMATE.name: Salvation

HOTSHIELD.description:
Create a healing wind around you, increasing your damage resistances by 0.4 for 5.
Heals you for $$HOTSHIELD_HOT.attributechangeovertime.totalchange$ Health over the duration of the healing breeze.

Coat your weapon with poison for Auto-Attacks for the next 40.
Each Auto-Attack poisons the targeted hide animal, dealing $$HOTSHIELD_HIDEMOB_BONUS_EFFECT.attributechangeovertime.totalchange$ magical damage over $$HOTSHIELD_HIDEMOB_BONUS_EFFECT.attributechangeovertime.totalduration$.
HOTSHIELD.name: Hide Animal Poison

HOVER_SPRINT.description:
Hover above the ground, increasing your Move Speed by $$HOVER_SPRINT_CHANNELING.buffovertime.value$ while channeling for up to $channeling.totalduration$.
Grants immunity to Roots and Slows.
HOVER_SPRINT.name: Hover

HOWL.description:
Release a sonic wave in a cone in front of you, dealing 62 magical damage.
Slows all enemies hit by 0.35 for 4.
Decreases damage dealt by 0.3 for 4.
Interrupts enemy spell casting.
HOWL.name: Howl

HUMAN_TORCH.description:
Torch the targeted enemy, dealing {0} magical damage over {1}.
The burning enemy and all enemies within a 4 radius will flee from you for 1.5.
While burning they leave a fiery trail which lasts 4.5.

The trail deals 26 magical damage (vs. players) / 28 magical damage (vs. mobs) every 0.5 (the damage can't be reflected).
Enemies touching the trail will flee from you for 1.5.
HUMAN_TORCH.name: Combustion

HYPER_FOCUS.description:
Become Hyper Focused, making all your Casts and Channels uninterruptible.
Grants immunity to Debuff (except damage over time effects).
Consumes 0.02 of your Max Energy every 1.

The ability can last up to 8 but can be deactivated earlier.
HYPER_FOCUS.name: Hyper Focus

ICEBLOCK2.description:
Freeze yourself in an uninterruptable channel, becoming immune to damage for {0} (can be used while stunned or silenced).

Negates all your Healing Received.
ICEBLOCK2.name: Ice Block

ICEROCK_EXPLODE.description:
Launch a giant snowball in the targeted direction, rolling over all enemies.
Deals 120 magical damage (damage cannot be reflected), knocking back all enemies hit by 10.

The snowball leaves behind a freezing trail, lasting 4.
Slows all enemies on it by 0.4.

If the snowball collides with terrain it will explode, dealing 160 magical damage (damage cannot be reflected) within a 5 radius.
ICEROCK_EXPLODE.name: Avalanche

ICESHARD.description:
Drop an ice shard on the targeted position, exploding in a 3 radius on impact.
Deals 130 magical damage (vs. players) / 130 magical damage (vs. mobs) to all enemies hit.
ICESHARD.name: Ice Shard

ICESTORM2.description:
Summon an ice storm with a $spelleffectarea.circle.radius_start$ radius, moving from the targeted position in the targeted direction for $spelleffectarea.node.distance_max$ and lasting for 15.
Deals 25 magical damage (vs. players) / 25 magical damage (vs. mobs) to all enemies within the storm every 0.5 (the damage can't be reflected).
Slows by 0.3.
ICESTORM2.name: Ice Storm

ICE_SCULPTURE.description:
Conjure a Glacial Obelisk at the targeted position, lasting up to 6.
Increases all damage and cooldown rate by 0.2 for up to 10 allies within a {3} radius of the Obelisk.

Recast the ability to detonate the Obelisk early, dealing 77 magical damage.
Slows all enemies hit by 0.4 for 4.

The Obelisk will automatically detonate after 6.
ICE_SCULPTURE.name: Glacial Obelisk

IMMORTAL.description:
Become Immortal, making it impossible to drop below 1 Health.
Become immune to enemy Transformation effects.
Consumes 0.02 of your Max Energy every 1.

The ability can last up to 5 but can be deactivated earlier.
IMMORTAL.name: Immortal

IMPULSE_PUNCH.description:
Unleash a powerful punch in a cone in front of you, dealing magical damage and slowing all enemies hit for 2 based on the type of armor the enemy is wearing.

[#] Armor: Plate or Mobs | Leather | other
[#] Damage: $$IMPULSE_PUNCH_PLATE.directattributechange.change | $$IMPULSE_PUNCH_LEATHER.directattributechange.change | $$IMPULSE_PUNCH_CLOTH.directattributechange.change
[#] Slow: 0.75 | 0.5 | 0.25

Enemies hit become immune to another Collapse for 1.
IMPULSE_PUNCH.name: Gravitational Collapse

INNERBLEEDING.description:
Swing your weapon in a 6 radius around you, dealing 58.59 physical damage.
Causes all enemies hit to bleed, dealing 20 physical damage every 0.5 while the bleeding enemy is moving within the next $$INNERBLEEDING_BLEED.attributechangeovertime.time$.
INNERBLEEDING.name: Internal Bleeding

INNER_CORRUPTION.description:
Reveal the Inner Corruption of the targeted enemy for 4 after 0.2.

If the target is a player:
Deals 63 magical damage whenever the target does a Auto-Attack or uses an ability (the damage can't be reflected).

If the target is a mob:
Deals $$INNER_CORRUPTION_MOB_EFFECT.attributechangeovertime.totalchange$ magical damage over the duration (the damage can't be reflected).
INNER_CORRUPTION.name: Inner Corruption

INTERRUPT2.description:
Bash the targeted enemy with your sword, interrupting the target's spell casting.
Deals 77.51 physical damage. 

Increases your Auto-Attack Damage by 0.2 for each Heroic Charge on you (stacks up to 3 times) for 5.
INTERRUPT2.name: Interrupt

INVISIBLE_WALK.description:
Take a spectral form, turning yourself invisible while channeling for up to {0} (can move while channeling; taking damage ends the channel).
Each 0.5 channeled costs 0.02 of your Max Energy.

Moving more than 15 decreases all damage you deal by 0.5 for 3.
INVISIBLE_WALK.name: Spectral Run

INVULNERABILITY.description:
Conjure an arcane shield in a 6.5 radius around the targeted ally, slowing yourself by 0.3 while channeling for {2} (can't be cast on self).
Absorbs up to 240 damage (before resistances).
Reapplies the shield every 1, costing 5 Energy.

The shield lasts up to 2 after the channel has ended.
INVULNERABILITY.name: Protective Beam

IRONBREAKER.description:
Slam your hammer on the ground, dealing 90 physical damage (vs players) / 120 physical damage (vs mobs) to all enemies in a {2} radius around the targeted position.
Reduces damage resistances by 0.12 for 4.
Breaks any shields active on all enemies hit.
IRONBREAKER.name: Iron Breaker

JUMP.description: Leap towards the targeted position, becoming immune to damage, debuffs, and Crowd Control effects until you land.
JUMP.name: Evasive Jump

JUMPSHOT2.description:
Fire an ice arrow $spelleffectarea.node.distance_max$ in front of you, which explodes in a $spelleffectarea.circle.radius_start$ radius.
Knocks you back by 13.
Deals 46.14 physical damage to all enemies hit.
Slows by 0.4 for 5.
JUMPSHOT2.name: Frost Shot

KNOCKBACKSHOT2.description:
Shoot a bolt in the targeted direction, knocking back the first enemy hit by 10.
Deals 62 physical damage.
Hitting an enemy will reduce your Cast Times and will increase your Auto-Attack Speed by 0.5 for 5.
KNOCKBACKSHOT2.name: Knockback Shot

KNOCKOUT.description:
Attack the targeted enemy, dealing 56.67 physical damage.
Puts the target to sleep for 5 (vs. players) / 5 (vs. mobs). (Taking damage wakes the enemy up.)
KNOCKOUT.name: Knockout

KNUCKLECOMBO.description:
Execute a two-punch combo on the targeted enemy while channeling for $channeling.totalduration$ (can't be interrupted).

The first punch deals 30 physical damage.
Stuns for 1.1.

The second punch deals 153 physical damage.
Knocks the target back by 3.
KNUCKLECOMBO.name: Devastating Combo

KNUCKLE_COUNTER.description:
Combine up to two abilities. The combo resets after 4.

1st Counter:
Enter a counter-stance while channeling for up to {1} (can't be interrupted).
Increase your Defense by 3 for 2.
Reflects 1.5 of incoming damage as magical damage.
If you take direct damage during that time, mark the first attacker, and enable the next combo ability.

2nd Follow Through:
Dash to the marked enemy, dealing 122 physical damage in a 4 radius.
Throws all enemies hit into the air for {5}.
KNUCKLE_COUNTER.name: Counter

LANCE_CHARGE.description:
Dash toward the targeted position, becoming immune to all Crowd Control effects until you reach the targeted position.
Purges all buffs from all enemies you pass through.
Deals 222 physical damage.
LANCE_CHARGE.name: Breakthrough

LAUNCHER.description:
Hit all enemies in a cone in front of you, throwing them in the air for {0}.
Deals 75 physical damage.

For every enemy player hit, the cooldown is reduced by 0.15 (stacks up to {3} times).
LAUNCHER.name: Rising Blow

LEGBREAKER.description:
Strike the targeted enemy, dealing 120 physical damage.
Slows by 0.15 for 4.
Decreases all damage dealt by 0.25 for 4.
Purges all Move Speed buffs.

If the targeted enemy has a Move Speed buff active, your Move Speed will be increased by 0.5 for 4.
LEGBREAKER.name: Cripple

LETHAL_CLEAVER.description:
Leap towards the targeted position and slam your axe into the ground, dealing 212 physical damage to all enemies in a $$LETHAL_CLEAVER_AREA.spelleffectarea.circle.radius_end$ radius.
Splits the earth in a cone in front of the impact area, throwing all enemies hit in the air for $$LETHAL_CLEAVER_EFFECT2.knockback.duration$.
Decreases Max and current Health by 0.15 for 5.
LETHAL_CLEAVER.name: Aftershock

LEVITATE.description:
Levitate above the ground, restoring 0.075 of your Max Health (not affected by your Healing Cast modifier) and 0.075 of your Max Energy every 1, while channeling for up to $channeling.totalduration$.
Increases your damage resistances by 0.4.
LEVITATE.name: Levitate

LIFESAVIOR.description:
Invoke a magical ward that lasts 1.5.

The next time you take damage while the ward is active, you will become immune to further damage for 3.
Increases all your damage and Healing Cast by 0.2.
LIFESAVIOR.name: Everlasting Spirit

LIFESTEALAURA.description:
Create a vicious aura with a 7 radius around you, lasting {1}.
Deals magical damage to up to 5 enemies based on your current Health every 1.

[#] Health: 80% | 60% | 40% | 20% | below 20%
[#] Damage: 16 | 20 | 24 | 28 | 32

Steals 1 (vs. players) / 0.5 (vs. mobs) of the Health the enemy has lost.
LIFESTEALAURA.name: Life Steal Aura

LIGHTNING_ARROW.description:
Shoot a storm-infused arrow in the targeted direction, which explodes into a $$LIGHTNING_ARROW_AREA.spelleffectarea.circle.radius_start$ radius stormcloud lasting 5 upon impact with an enemy.
Deals 21 magical damage every 0.3 (this damage cannot be reflected).

Enemies leaving the area will continue to take $$LIGHTNING_ARROW_EFFECT.attributechangeovertime.totalchange$ magical damage over $$LIGHTNING_ARROW_EFFECT.attributechangeovertime.totalduration$ (this also happens after the cloud disappears).

Whenever the ability deals damage, it will interrupt the hit enemy's spell casting.
LIGHTNING_ARROW.name: Raging Storm

MACELEAP.description:
Leap towards the targeted position, becoming immune to all Crowd Control effects, Debuffs, and damage until impact.
Deals 203 physical damage in a 5 radius on impact.
Slows all enemies hit by 0.3 for 3.
Enemies within 3 radius will be stunned for 1.8.
MACELEAP.name: Deep Leap

MACE_CRYSTAL_FRAGMENT_STORM.description:
Combine up to three abilities. The combo resets after 4. 

1st & 2nd Dreadstorm Sweep: 
Swing your weapon in a cone in front of you, dealing 50 physical damage to all enemies hit. 
If you hit at least one enemy, gain one Eye of the Storm charge. 

3rd Dreadstorm Surge: 
Smash the ground in front of you, dealing 109 physical damage in a 4 radius. 
Casting this ability grants you one Eye of the Storm charge. 

Eye of the Storm: 
Become the center of a storm that grows in size based on your Eye of the Storm charges, lasting 5. 
Reduces damage resistances of all enemies in the storm by 0.18 and slows them by 0.25.

[#] Eye of the Storm Charges: 1 | 2 | 3
[#] Eye of the Storm Radius: 6 | 7.5 | 9
MACE_CRYSTAL_FRAGMENT_STORM.name: Eye of the Storm

MAGICCIRCLE.description:
Place a magic rune with a $spelleffectarea.circle.radius_start$ radius under your feet, lasting 6.
Increases magical damage and Healing Cast by 0.1 and reduces Cast Times by 0.1 for up to 6 allies for every 1 they stand on the rune (stacks up to 6 times).
The effect lasts for 5 after they leave the area of the rune (this also happens after the rune disappears).
MAGICCIRCLE.name: Magic Rune

MAGICMUSHROOM.description:
Release a cloud of magical pollen in a 6 radius around you, putting all enemies hit to sleep for 3 (taking damage wakes the enemy).
Turns you invisible for 3 (taking damage, attacking, using an ability, or interacting with an object will reveal you).
MAGICMUSHROOM.name: Magic Pollen

MAGICSHOCK.description:
Release a magic shock, silencing all enemies in a 3 radius for 0.85.
Deals 150 magical damage to all enemies hit.
MAGICSHOCK.name: Magic Shock

MAGMASPHERE.description:
Release a devastating magma sphere in the targeted direction, rolling through all enemies
Deals 240 magical damage.

Enemy players who are unmounted will take $$MAGMASPHERE_EFFECT.attributechangeovertime.totalchange$ of their Max Health as true damage over $$MAGMASPHERE_EFFECT.attributechangeovertime.time$ (this damage can't be reflected).
MAGMASPHERE.name: Magma Sphere

MAJESTIC_SMASH.description:
Swing your sword in a 6 radius around you, throwing all enemies hit in the air for {1}.
Deals 44 physical damage.

While the enemies are in the air you follow up with a vertical smash, dealing physical damage in a line in front of and behind you based on the amount of Heroic Charges on you.

[#] Heroic Charges: 0 | 1 | 2 | 3
[#] Damage: 91.35 | 147 | 220.5 | 311.85

Consumes all your Heroic Charges.

Dealing a finishing blow on a player increases the damage of all allies within 11 by 0.2 for 5.
MAJESTIC_SMASH.name: Majestic Smash

MANADRAIN.description: Generate Energy for you and allies for $pulsingspell.time$. For each enemy within a 6 radius around you, you will restore 5 Energy every 1 for up to 10 allies within a 15 radius (stacks up to 5 times).
MANADRAIN.name: Energy Source

MAXHEALTHBUFF.description: Grow to a giant form, increasing your Max and Current Health by 0.25, and your Move Speed by 0.25 for 6 (can't be purged).
MAXHEALTHBUFF.name: Giant

METEOR.description:
Call down a meteor, impacting after 1 at the targeted position.
Deals 434.09 magical damage to all enemies in a 5 radius (this damage cannot be reflected).
Knocks back all enemies hit by 3.
METEOR.name: Meteor

MIGHTYBLOW.description:
Leap towards the targeted enemy, interrupting their spell casting.
Deals physical damage based on the amount of Heroic Charges on you.

[#] Heroic Charges: 0 | 1 | 2 | 3
[#] Damage: 80 | 128 | 192 | 271

Dealing the finishing blow will reduce this ability's cooldown by 1.
MIGHTYBLOW.name: Mighty Blow

MIGHTYSWING.description:
Slice the air to shoot a demonic wave in the targeted direction, piercing through all enemies and dealing 170 magical damage. Consumes Heroic Charges for one of the following secondary effects.

[#] 1 Heroic Charge: Slows by 0.3 for 2.25
[#] 2 Heroic Charges: Silences for 2.25
[#] 3 Heroic Charges: Deals additional $$MIGHTYSWING_EFFECT3.attributechangeovertime.totalchange$ magical damage
MIGHTYSWING.name: Crescent Slash

MIMIC.description:
Mimic the targeted player, granting access to a second-slot ability based on the weapon equipped by the target for 20.

Casting Mimic on an Arcane Staff wielder will grant you access to Magic Shock (the cooldown is independent from the Magic Shock you can select as your first-slot ability).

The ability goes on cooldown if you either cast the mimicked ability or do not cast it while you have access to it.
If you cast the mimicked ability of another weapon, its cooldown is reduced by 0.2.
MIMIC.name: Mimic

MIST_WALKER.description:
Turn into a Mist Cloud with a 7 radius, granting immunity to All Effects and slowing yourself by 0.3.
Allies inside the Mist turn invisible. (Attacking, using an ability, or interacting with an object will reveal yourself or allies temporarily).

The ability can last up to 5 but can be deactivated earlier.
MIST_WALKER.name: Mist Cloud

MOVEMENTSHIELD.description:
Surround yourself with a shield, absorbing up to 300 damage while channeling for up to $channeling.totalduration$ (can move while channeling).
Increases Move Speed by 0.8 and Max Load by 0.8 while the shield is active.
Drop any object you are escorting.
MOVEMENTSHIELD.name: Sprint Shield

MULTISHOT2.description:
Release a volley of arrows in a cone in front of you, dealing 94 physical damage (vs. players) / 116 physical damage (vs. mobs).
Slows by 0.3 for 1.
MULTISHOT2.name: Multishot

NASTY_WOUNDS.description:
Conjure a swirl of energy in a $spelleffectarea.circle.radius_end$ radius around you, lasting 4.
Deals 10 magical damage every 0.5 to all enemies within the swirl (this damage cannot be reflected).

Enemies entering the swirl for the first time will have their Healing Received and Healing Cast decreased by 0.5 for 4.
NASTY_WOUNDS.name: Nasty Wounds

NATURERESILIENCE.description: Grant nature's protection to a targeted ally, increasing the ally's damage resistances by 0.2 and Healing Received by 0.4 for 6.
