Conjure a 4.5m circle to move 14m over 4s, slowing enemies by 10%.
Enemies that cast abilities while in the area, recieve 150% of the ability's normal cooldown.
PROTOTYPE_CD_PENALTY.name: Increase Cooldowns

PROTOTYPE_CLEAR_MIND.description:
Gain 4 stacks of 20% movement speed for up to 6s.
The next 4 ability uses refund 20% of the cooldown of all weapon ability slots, and remove one stack of movement speed.
PROTOTYPE_CLEAR_MIND.name: Clear Mind

PROTOTYPE_DISORIENT.description:
Slow down 40% and scream so loudly that you progressively disorient enemies in a 7m radius around you while channeling for up to 1.5s (can't be interrupted).
Slow enemies in the area by 20%.
If enemies are still within the area for the whole 1.5s, they are disoriented for up to 3 but any damage will break the disorientation.
PROTOTYPE_DISORIENT.name: Disorienting Shriek

PROTOTYPE_FLARE.description:
Shoot a flare towards the targeted position growing from 4m to 7.5m over 5s.
Enemies in the area are revealed, cannot go invisible, and have their cooldowns paused.
PROTOTYPE_FLARE.name: Illuminating Flare

PROTOTYPE_GLIDE.description: Not working. Will be fixed turn radius movement + charm
PROTOTYPE_GLIDE.name: Glide

PROTOTYPE_ICESHIELD.description:
Shield near-by allies for 100.
If any shield is broken before the 2.5 duration expires, it explodes, applying one Clinging Frost Stack to enemies in a 5 radius.

[#] 1 Chiling Frost Stack: Slows by 0.4 for 3.
[#] 2 Chilling Frost Stacks: Stuns for 1.5
PROTOTYPE_ICESHIELD.name: Clinging Frost

PROTOTYPE_IMMUNEAREA.description:
Place a 7m immunity field on the ground for 5s.
While you are in the area, you are immune to all damage or CC from enemies outside of the area.
While in the area, all damage and cooldown reduction increased by 15%.
PROTOTYPE_IMMUNEAREA.name: Immunity Area

PROTOTYPE_SKYFALL.description:
Start gliding, increasing movement speed by 100% for up to 3s.
While gliding, gain *big* CC resistance and become immune to Slows.
Clump enemies in a 5.5m radius on landing.
PROTOTYPE_SKYFALL.name: Sky Fall

PULSINGHEAL.description:
Release a Sacred Pulse from the targeted ally, restoring 94 Health.

Deals 112 magical damage (vs. players) / 168 magical damage (vs. mobs) in a 5 radius.
Enemy players will be knocked back by 9.
Mobs will be thrown into the air for {5}.
PULSINGHEAL.name: Sacred Pulse

PUMMELING_STRIKES.description:
Release a flurry of fists in a cone in front of you while channeling for up to $channeling.totalduration$ (can't be interrupted).
Deals 36 physical damage (vs players) / 36 physical damage (vs mobs) every 0.5.
The cone slowly follows the cursor position.

2 after the last Striking Fist hits, the enemy will take an additional 30 magical damage for each hit they received (stacks up to 10 times, damage can't be reflected).
PUMMELING_STRIKES.name: Hundred Striking Fists

PURGE_HELMET.description: Purge all buffs from the targeted enemy after 0.4.
PURGE_HELMET.name: Purge

PURGINGSHIELD.description:
Create a magic barrier, increasing your damage resistances by 0.32 for 8.

Whenever you take damage, all buffs on the attacker will be purged (except healing over time effects).
PURGINGSHIELD.name: Purging Shield

PURGINGSHIELD2.description:
Create a purging shield on yourself, increasing your Defense by 0.5 for 4.
Whenever you take direct damage, all buffs on the attacker will be purged (except healing over time effects).
PURGINGSHIELD2.name: Purging Shield

PURIFYING_SMOKE.description:
Conjure Purifying Smoke in a 4 radius around the targeted position after 0.4, cleansing all Crowd Control effects and debuffs (except damage over time effects) from all allies in the smoke.
Purges all buffs of all enemies within the smoke.
PURIFYING_SMOKE.name: Purifying Smoke

PYROBLAST_SKILLSHOT.description:
Charge up a Pyroblast, while channeling for up to $channeling.totalduration$.
Deals magical damage upon impact with an enemy within a 4 radius based on how long you have channeled

[#] Time: 0s | 0.6s | 1.2s
[#] Damage: $$PYROBLAST_SKILLSHOT_EFFECT.directattributechange.valueoverride.ifcharge.value$ | $$PYROBLAST_SKILLSHOT_EFFECT.directattributechange.valueoverride.ifcharge.value$ | $$PYROBLAST_SKILLSHOT_EFFECT.directattributechange.valueoverride.ifcharge.value$

If you channel for $channeling.totalduration$ the Pyroblast will also knock back all enemies hit by 2.5.
PYROBLAST_SKILLSHOT.name: Pyroblast

QDASH.description:
Leap towards the targeted position, dealing 75 physical damage to all enemies in a 3 radius.
Applies one Assassin Spirit on you for every enemy hit.

Hitting at least one enemy will restore 6 Energy.

Each Assassin Spirit Charge increases all your damage by 0.06 for 8 (stacks up to 3 times).
QDASH.name: Deadly Swipe

QSTAFF_COMBO.description:
Swing your weapon up to 3 times in the target direction, dealing 80 physical damage each hit.
Hitting an enemy with all three swings increases your Move Speed by 0.3, and Auto-Attack Damage by 0.3 for 4.
QSTAFF_COMBO.name: Gale Dance

QSWHIRLWIND.description:
Whirl your staff in a 5 radius around you, dealing 55 physical damage every 0.5, while channeling for {3} (can move while channeling).
Increases damage resistances by 0.15 for 5.

Enemy players will be knocked back by 12 (ignoring crowd control resistance).
Mobs will have their spell casting interrupted.
QSWHIRLWIND.name: Hurricane

QS_CRYSTAL_COMBO.description:
Combine up to {0} abilities. The combo resets after 5

1st & 2nd Phantom Twin:
Summon a projection for 2, slashing around itself in a {3} radius at the targeted position and moving {4} away from you.
Deals 46 physical damage every 0.4 within the radius (damage cannot be reflected).
Slows by 0.15.

3rd Phantom Slash:
Slam the ground in a {8} radius around the targeted position in sync with a projection, throwing all enemies hit in the air for {9}.
Deals 131 physical damage.
QS_CRYSTAL_COMBO.name: Phantom Twin

QS_SLOWROPE.description:
Conjure a cloud of Mystic Rocks in a 6.5 radius around you, slowing all enemies within it by 0.5.
Reduces their Healing Received by 0.5.
Increases your damage resistances by 0.2.

Negates all your Healing Received.

The ability lasts up to 15 but can be deactivated sooner.
QS_SLOWROPE.name: Mystic Rocks

QS_WHIRLWIND2.description:
Swing your staff in a 6 radius around you, knocking back all enemies hit by 4.26.
Deals 51.81 physical damage.
Decreases all damage dealt by 0.5 for 5.

Affected players will be unable to Auto-Attack.
Affected mobs will have their Auto-Attack Speed reduced by 0.5.
QS_WHIRLWIND2.name: Forceful Swing

RAM_CHARGE.description:
Leap towards the targeted position, becoming immune to all Crowd Control effects and damage until impact.
Stuns all enemies in a 5.5 radius for 2.5.
Deals 98.28 physical damage.
Throws all enemies hit in the air for a duration based on the number of enemies hit (ignoring Crowd Control Resistance and duration modifiers).

[#] Enemies Hit Thresholds: 1 | 4 | 7
[#] Duration: {6} | {7} | {8}
RAM_CHARGE.name: Ground Pound

RAPIERSTAB.description:
Dash towards the targeted position, dealing physical damage to all enemies you pass through based on their current Health.

[#] Target Health: Above $$RAPIERSTAB_EFFECT2.applyspell.IfTargetHealthPercentage.value$ | Below $$RAPIERSTAB_EFFECT2.applyspell.IfTargetHealthPercentage.value$ 
[#] Damage: 153.32 | 330

Hitting at least one enemy player below $$RAPIERSTAB_EFFECT2.applyspell.IfTargetHealthPercentage.value$ Health will reduce this ability's cooldown by 0.5.
RAPIERSTAB.name: Lunging Stabs

REANIMATE.description:
Revitalize the targeted ally, restoring 80 Health and 80 Energy every 1, while channeling for $channeling.totalduration$ (taking damage reduces the channel time).
Each 1 channeled costs 4 Energy.
REANIMATE.name: Revitalize

REFLECTAREA.description:
Create an aura with a 7 radius around you while channeling for $channeling.totalduration$ (can move while channeling and can't be interrupted).
Reflects 0.5 of incoming damage to you and up to 9 allies as magical damage.
Increases all damage resistances of the affected allies by 0.43.

Decreases your damage resistances by 0.37.
REFLECTAREA.name: Protection of the Fiends

REFLECT_CHANNEL.description:
Create a magic shield, slowing yourself by 0.3 while channeling for {1} (can't be interrupted).
Increases your damage resistances by 0.4.

Whenever you take damage, the shield shoots a magic orb, silencing the attacker for 2 on impact.
Deals 27 magical damage.
REFLECT_CHANNEL.name: Requite

REJUVENATING_BREEZE.description:
Release a Rejuvenating Breeze from the targeted ally, increasing the target's damage resistances by 0.32 for 2.
The breeze hits up to 20 allies within a 15 radius around the target.
All allies hit receive the same number of Rejuvenation Charges as the targeted ally has.

Each Rejuvenation Charge restores $$REJUVENATION_STACK.attributechangeovertime.totalchange$ Health over $$REJUVENATION_STACK.attributechangeovertime.totalduration$ and increases other allies' Defense vs. mobs by 0.05263 (stacks up to 3 times).
REJUVENATING_BREEZE.name: Rejuvenating Breeze

REJUVENATION.description:
Renew the targeted ally's strength, applying one Rejuvenation Charge.

Each Rejuvenation Charge restores $$REJUVENATION_STACK.attributechangeovertime.totalchange$ Health over $$REJUVENATION_STACK.attributechangeovertime.totalduration$ and increases other allies' Defense vs. mobs by 0.05263 (stacks up to 3 times).

If the target already has 3 Rejuvenation Charges, all charges will be consumed and you restore 7 Energy.
REJUVENATION.name: Rejuvenation

REJUVMUSHROOM_GRENADE.description:
Plant a magical flower at the targeted position, lasting 20.

An Ally walking over the flower will consume it, restoring Health and applying Rejuvenation Charges on up to 15 allies within a 5 radius based on how long the flower grew.

[#] Time: 0s | 1.5s | 3s
[#] Healing: 17 | 42 | 71
[#] Rejuvenation Charges: 1 | 2 | 3

Each Rejuvenation Charge restores $$REJUVENATION_STACK.attributechangeovertime.totalchange$ Health over $$REJUVENATION_STACK.attributechangeovertime.totalduration$ and increases other allies' Defense vs. mobs by 0.05263 (stacks up to 3 times).
REJUVMUSHROOM_GRENADE.name: Rejuvenating Flower

RENDINGCOMBO.description:
Combine up to two abilities. The combo resets after 2.5.

1st and 2nd Rending Rage:
Cleave all enemies in a cone in the targeted direction, dealing 50 physical damage.
Applies one Rending Bleed Charge. 

3rd Raging Leap:
Leap towards the targeted position, rooting all enemies in a 5 radius for 1.
Deals 50 physical damage.

Each Rending Bleed Charge deals $$AXE_BLEED.attributechangeovertime.totalchange$ physical damage over $$AXE_BLEED.attributechangeovertime.time$ (stacks up to 3 times).
If the maximum amount of stacks is reached, the affected enemies' Healing Received is reduced by 0.12 for 5.
RENDINGCOMBO.name: Rending Rage

RENDINGSPIN.description:
Swing your axe in a 2.5 radius around you, dealing physical damage based on the distance from you.
Applies one Rending Bleed Charge to all enemies hit.
 
[#] Distance: 2.5 | 2.5
[#] Damage: 70 | 80
 
Each Rending Bleed Charge deals $$AXE_BLEED.attributechangeovertime.totalchange$ physical damage over $$AXE_BLEED.attributechangeovertime.time$ (stacks up to 3 times).
If the maximum amount of stacks is reached, the affected enemies' Healing Received is reduced by 0.12 for 5.
RENDINGSPIN.name: Rending Spin

RENDINGSTRIKE.description:
Attack the targeted enemy, dealing 59 physical damage.
Applies one Rending Bleed Charge.

Each Rending Bleed Charge deals $$AXE_BLEED.attributechangeovertime.totalchange$ physical damage over $$AXE_BLEED.attributechangeovertime.time$ (stacks up to 3 times).
If the maximum amount of stacks is reached, the affected enemies' Healing Received is reduced by 0.12 for 5.
RENDINGSTRIKE.name: Rending Strike

RENDINGSWING.description:
Cleave through all enemies in a 7 radius around you, dealing 125 physical damage.
Decreases Crowd Control Resistance by 0.2 for 4.
If any enemy hit has Rending Bleed Charges, all enemies hit receive the same number of charges as the enemy with the most charges.

Each Rending Bleed Charge deals $$AXE_BLEED.attributechangeovertime.totalchange$ physical damage over $$AXE_BLEED.attributechangeovertime.time$ (stacks up to 3 times).
If the maximum amount of stacks is reached, the affected enemies' Healing Received is reduced by 0.12 for 5.
RENDINGSWING.name: Tear Apart

RESURRECTION.description:
Reawaken a knocked-down ally, restoring 0.3 of the target's Max Health.

Reawakened allies cannot be reawakened again for 180.
RESURRECTION.name: Reawaken

RETALIATE2.description:
Conjure a magical barrier, increasing your damage resistances by 0.2 for 3.
Reflects 0.85 of incoming damage as magical damage.
RETALIATE2.name: Retaliate

ROOTFIELD.description:
Combine up to two abilities. The combo resets after 5.

1st Close In:
Dash towards the targeted position. 

2nd Gravitas:
Conjure a high gravity field with a 5 radius around you, rooting all enemies (ignoring crowd control resistance), while channeling for up to {4} (can't be interrupted).
At the end of the channel enemies will remain rooted for 1.5.

Hitting less than 3 enemy players will end the root after 1.5 (mobs are unaffected by this condition).
ROOTFIELD.name: Gravitas

ROOTSHIELD.description:
Conjure a shield on yourself, absorbing up to 392 damage (before resistances) for the next 10.

If the shield is broken, it will explode in a 6 radius.
Deals 84.29 magical damage to all enemies hit.
Roots for 4.43 (enemies taking additional damage are freed).
ROOTSHIELD.name: Spirit of Vengeance

ROTTENVINES.description:
Conjure an aura with a 9 radius, increasing your Move Speed by $$ROTTENVINES_CHANNELING.buffovertime.value$ while channeling for up to $channeling.totalduration$ (can't be interrupted).
Restores 33 Health (when used alone) / 33 Health (when healing at least one ally) every 0.8 for up to 10 allies.
ROTTENVINES.name: Elevated Nature

ROYAL_BANNER.description:
Carry the Royal Banner, creating an aura with a 5 radius around you lasting 7.
Increases Auto-Attack Speed by 0.3.
Increases Cooldown Rate by 0.3 for you and by 0.3 for up to 10 allies.
ROYAL_BANNER.name: Royal Banner

ROYAL_MARCH.description:
March towards the targeted position.
Increases your Move Speed by 0.09 on arrival, for every 0.25 you have marched (stacks up to 10 times) for 8.
Grants immunity to Roots and Slows.

If you don't reach the targeted position, the effect will be negated.
ROYAL_MARCH.name: Royal March

SACRED_GROUND.description:
Create a sacred circle with a $spelleffectarea.circle.radius_end$ radius that lasts 3.
Silences and slows all enemies inside by 0.2

Mobs will become immune to the silence after 5.
SACRED_GROUND.name: Sacred Ground

SACRIFICE_HEAL.description:
Sacrifice yourself for the targeted ally (can't be cast on self), healing the target for 0.15 of their Max Health.
Take 0.15 of your Max Health as true damage.
SACRIFICE_HEAL.name: Sacrifice

SCYTHESWING.description:
Reap all enemies in a 5 radius around you after 0.5, dealing 98 physical damage.
Follow up with a second swing after 0.4, dealing physical damage over {4} to all enemies hit based on their current Health.

[#] Target Health: Above 0.4 | Below 0.4 
[#] Damage: {7} | {8}
SCYTHESWING.name: Bloody Reap

SEARING_FLAME.description:
Combine up to two abilities. The combo resets after 5.

1st, 2nd & 3rd Searing Flame:
Fire a Searing Flame in the targeted direction, dealing 99 magical damage to the first enemy hit.
Ignites the enemy, dealing $$SEARING_FLAME_DOT.attributechangeovertime.totalchange$ magical damage over $$SEARING_FLAME_DOT.attributechangeovertime.time$.
Hit at least one enemy to continue the combo.

4th Furious Flame:
Fire a Furious Flame in the targeted direction, dealing 200 magical damage.
Ignites the enemy, dealing $$SEARING_FLAME_DOT.attributechangeovertime.totalchange$ magical damage over $$SEARING_FLAME_DOT.attributechangeovertime.time$.
SEARING_FLAME.name: Searing Flame

SELF_CLEANSE.description: Create a purifying circle with a 4 radius at your feet, cleansing all Crowd Control effects and debuffs (except damage over time effects; can be used while stunned or silenced) from all allies within the circle.
SELF_CLEANSE.name: Cleanse

SEPARATING_SLAM.description:
Attack the targeted enemy, dealing 157 physical damage.
Roots the target for 2.2.

Deals 80 physical damage to all untargeted enemies within a 6 radius around the target, knocking back all enemy players hit by 12 (ignoring Crowd Control Resistances).
Untargeted enemy mobs will be thrown in the air for {4}.
SEPARATING_SLAM.name: Separator

SHAPESHIFT_AVALONIAN_EAGLE.description:
Transform into a Dawnbird for up to 20.
This changes your abilities and stats.
[#] Offensive: high
[#] Defensive: low
[#] Energy Regeneration: very high

Airborne
Grants immunity to Root Effects.
Transforming while having {0} Shift Charges active, will increase your Movement Speed by 0.6 for 3.
SHAPESHIFT_AVALONIAN_EAGLE.name: Dawnbird Transformation

SHAPESHIFT_BEAR.description:
Transform into a Spirit Bear for up to 30.
This changes your abilities and stats.
[#] Offensive: low
[#] Defensive: high
[#] Energy Regeneration: very high

Enrage
While your Health is below {0} your Damage and Duration of your Crowd Control effects will increase by 0.2 and your Cast Speed will increase by 0.4.
SHAPESHIFT_BEAR.name: Spirit Bear Transformation

SHAPESHIFT_CRYSTAL_COBRA.description:
Transform into a Crystal Cobra for up to 15.
This changes your abilities and stats.
[#] Offensive: medium
[#] Defensive: medium
[#] Energy Regeneration: very high

Slippery
The next time you are Stunned or Rooted, Cleanse yourself, and gain 0.4 Move Speed and Immunity to Stuns and Roots for 2.
SHAPESHIFT_CRYSTAL_COBRA.name: Crystal Cobra Transformation

SHAPESHIFT_ENT.description:
Transform into an Sylvian for up to 20.
This changes your abilities and stats.
[#] Offensive: medium
[#] Defensive: medium
[#] Energy Regeneration: very high

Growth
Increases the Max and Current Health of up to {0} allies in a 11 radius around you by 0.08.
SHAPESHIFT_ENT.name: Sylvian Transformation

SHAPESHIFT_IMP.description:
Transform into a Hellfire Imp for up to 30.
This changes your abilities and stats.
[#] Offensive: very high
[#] Defensive: very low
[#] Energy Regeneration: very high

Return from Hell
If at least 3 Shift Charges are active on you, when your Health would drop to 0, you become immune to death and heal for {2} of your Max Health over 3.5.
While healing you are stunned and immune to damage.
Hellfire Imp Transformation's cooldown is increased to 60.
SHAPESHIFT_IMP.name: Hellfire Imp Transformation

SHAPESHIFT_PANTHER.description:
Transform into a Shadow Panther for up to 12.
This changes your abilities and stats.
[#] Offensive: high
[#] Defensive: low
[#] Energy Regeneration: very high

On the Prowl
If no enemies are within in a 9 radius around you for 1, you will turn invisible to players, but reduce your Movement Speed by 0.3.
While invisible, enemies within in a 25 radius will be alerted.
SHAPESHIFT_PANTHER.name: Shadow Panther Transformation

SHAPESHIFT_ROCK_ELEMENTAL.description:
Transform into a Runestone Golem for up to 18.
This changes your abilities and stats.
[#] Offensive: low
[#] Defensive: high
[#] Energy Regeneration: very high

Giant Consumption
Grants immunity to all Forced Movement Effects.
Increases your max and current Health based on the amount of Shift Charges on you.

[#] Charges: 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5
[#] Health Increase: 0.1 | 0.15 | 0.2 | 0.25 | 0.3

Consumes 1 Shift Charge every 3.
SHAPESHIFT_ROCK_ELEMENTAL.name: Runestone Golem Transformation

SHAPESHIFT_WEREWOLF.description:
Transform into a Werewolf for up to 20.
This changes your abilities and stats.
[#] Offensive: medium
[#] Defensive: medium
[#] Energy Regeneration: very high

Bloody Roar
While your Health is below 0.4, Tear Open and Rip Through steal 0.08 of the Health the enemy has lost.
SHAPESHIFT_WEREWOLF.name: Werewolf Transformation

SHAPE_Q_CAST.description:
Shoot a projectile of unstable energy at target enemy, dealing 72 magical damage to the target and shattering in a cone behind them.
Deals 44 magical damage to all enemies hit by the cone.
Applies one Shift Charge on you.

Shift Charges are consumed to empower the abilities of your shape (stacks are removed when mounting up).
SHAPE_Q_CAST.name: Unstable Projectile

SHAPE_Q_CONE_MELEE.description:
Cast a shockwave in front of you, dealing 97 magical damage.
Decreases damage resistances by 0.02 for 6 (stacks up to 3 times).
Each enemy hit applies one Shift Charge on you (up to 2 times).

Shift Charges are consumed to empower the abilities of your shape (stacks are removed when mounting up).
SHAPE_Q_CONE_MELEE.name: Pulse Shock

SHAPE_Q_DAMAGE_AND_SHIELD.description:
Unleash unstable energy at the target position, dealing 70 magical damage to enemies.
Applies a shield to yourself and up to 5 allies that absorbs 150 damage for 2.

Hitting at least one enemy will apply one Shift Charge on you.
Hitting at least one ally will apply one Shift Charge on you.

Shift Charges are consumed to empower the abilities of your shape (stacks are removed when mounting up).
SHAPE_Q_DAMAGE_AND_SHIELD.name: Adapting Matter

SHAPE_Q_SKILLSHOT.description:
Combine up to two abilities. The combo resets after 5.

1st Reality Crack
Cause a brief crack in reality into the targeted direction, dealing 101 magical damage to all enemies hit.
Hitting at least one enemy will apply one Shift Charge on you and continue the combo.

2nd Reality Fissure
Create a fissure in reality into the targeted direction, dealing 123 magical damage to all enemies hit.
Hitting at least one enemy will apply one Shift Charge on you and continue the combo.

Shift Charges are consumed to empower the abilities of your shape (stacks are removed when mounting up).
SHAPE_Q_SKILLSHOT.name: Reality Fissure

SHAPE_W_AREA_PULL.description:
Shoot out tendrils in the targeted direction, pulling up to 5 enemies towards you, rooting them for 1.35.
Deals 85 magical damage to all enemies hit.

Each enemy hit applies one Shift Charge on you (up to 2 times).

Shift Charges are consumed to empower the abilities of your shape (stacks are removed when mounting up).
SHAPE_W_AREA_PULL.name: Positional Drift

SHAPE_W_DAMAGE_AOE.description:
Conjure a cloud of distorted reality with a {0} radius at the targeted location, lasting 3.
Deals 48 magical damage every 0.75 (this damage cannot be reflected).
Slows all enemies within it by 0.1.

Each enemy hit applies one Shift Charge on you (up to 2 times).

Shift Charges are consumed to empower the abilities of your shape (stacks are removed when mounting up).
SHAPE_W_DAMAGE_AOE.name: Distortion

SHAPE_W_POLYMORPH.description:
Shoot an energy orb in the target direction, transforming the first unmounted, not transformed player hit into a helpless animal for 2.5.
Hitting a mob or transformed player will decrease their max and current Health by 0.15 for 5 instead.
The affected player becomes immune to Polymorph's non damage effects for 5.

The Orb explodes on impact, dealing 110 magical damage in a 4 radius.

Hitting at least one enemy will apply one Shift Charge on you.

Shift Charges are consumed to empower the abilities of your Shape (stacks are removed when mounting).
SHAPE_W_POLYMORPH.name: Polymorph

SHAPE_W_TETHERBEAM.description:
Attach a tether to an unmounted target (cannot be cast on self).

Attaching to an ally:
Applies a shield that absorbs 300 damage for 2.
If the ally is a guild, alliance or party member, pull them to your position.

Attaching to an enemy: 
Dash towards the attached enemy.
Applies a shield to yourself that absorbs 100 damage for 2.
SHAPE_W_TETHERBEAM.name: Tether Shift

SHATTER_Q.description:
Freeze the ground in front of you along a 16 long and $spelleffectarea.rectangle.width_max$ wide path, dealing 90 magical damage.
Slows all enemies hit by 0.2 for 3.
SHATTER_Q.name: Frozen Surge

SHIELDFRIENDLY.description:
Protect the targeted ally with arcane energy, applying a shield that absorbs up to 300 damage (before resistances) during the next 2.
Grants immunity to Forced Movement effects.
SHIELDFRIENDLY.name: Arcane Protection

SHOCKWAVE.description:
Send a transcendent raven in the targeted direction, piercing through all enemies and dealing 106.6 physical damage.
Inflicts a bleed dealing $$SHOCKWAVE_EFFECT.attributechangeovertime.totalchange$ physical damage over $$SHOCKWAVE_EFFECT.attributechangeovertime.time$.
Reduces Healing Received by 0.4 for 4.
SHOCKWAVE.name: Morgana Raven

SHOCKWAVE_PUNCH.description:
Combine up to two abilities. The combo resets after 2.5.

1st Shockwave:
Shoot a Shockwave in the targeted direction, piercing through all enemies.
Deals 117 magical damage to all enemies hit.
Hitting at least one enemy enables the next combo ability.

2nd Rushdown:
Dash to the first enemy hit by the Shockwave.
SHOCKWAVE_PUNCH.name: Shockwave

SHOULDERTACKLE.description: Dash towards the targeted position, throwing all enemies within a 4 radius of the targeted position in the air for $$SHOULDERTACKLE_KNOCKBACK.knockback.duration$ (ignoring Crowd Control Resistance) on impact.
SHOULDERTACKLE.name: Elbow Smash

SHOVEL.description:
Fling the targeted enemy, pulling them 10 behind you.
Deals physical damage based on the amount of Spirit Spear Charges on you.

[#] Spirit Spear Charges: 0 | 1 | 2 | 3
[#] Damage: 56 | 56 | 56 | 56
SHOVEL.name: Fling

SHRIEKMACE.description:
Summon a magic circle with a 6 radius, silencing all enemies hit for 2.33 and Purging all buffs from them.
Affected mobs will have their Auto-Attack Damage reduced by 0.4 for 4.
Increases your threat towards all mobs hit by 156.
SHRIEKMACE.name: Battle Howl

SHRINKINGSMASH.description:
Wind up for 0.6 to perform a shrinking smash in a cone in front of you, decreasing max and current Health of all enemies hit by 0.4 and their damage dealt and Healing Cast by 0.4 for 8.
Deals 98.28 magical damage.
SHRINKINGSMASH.name: Shrinking Curse

SILENCINGBOLT.description:
Release a bolt in the targeted direction, silencing the first enemy hit for 3.83 on impact.
Deals 146.25 physical damage.
SILENCINGBOLT.name: Noise Eraser

SKILLSHOT_FIREBALL.description:
Cast a Flare in the targeted direction, exploding on impact with an enemy.
Deals 205 magical damage in a 5 radius.
Ignites all enemies hit by the explosion, dealing $$SKILLSHOT_FIREBALL_EFFECT.attributechangeovertime.totalchange$ magical damage over $$SKILLSHOT_FIREBALL_EFFECT.attributechangeovertime.time$.
SKILLSHOT_FIREBALL.name: Raging Flare

SKILLSHOT_PULL.description:
Throw your weapon in the targeted direction, pulling the first enemy hit towards you.

Create a Well of Life with a $spelleffectarea.circle.radius_start$ radius at the targeted position, lasting 4.
Heals up to 20 allies within the Well for 69 Health every 1.
WELLOFLIFE2.name: Well Of Life

WHIRLING_STAFF.description: Whirl your staff around, dealing 40 physical damage every 0.25 in a 5 radius while channeling for up to {3} (can move while channeling).
WHIRLING_STAFF.name: Whirling Strikes

WILD_MAGIC.description:
Rotate every 1 through 3 different magical effects. Recasting the ability selects the effect.

1st Ring of Fire:
Create a Ring of Fire with a $$WILD_MAGIC_FIRE.spelleffectarea.arc.innerradius_start$ radius on the ground around you, lasting 3. Sets all enemies touching it aflame, dealing $$WILD_MAGIC_FIRE_EFFECT.attributechangeovertime.totalchange$ magical damage over $$WILD_MAGIC_FIRE_EFFECT.attributechangeovertime.time$. Burning enemies will flee from you for 1 (mobs flee only once).

2nd Storm Shield:
Increases your damage resistances by 0.22 for 5. Whenever you take direct damage, shock the attacker if within 12 of you, dealing 20 magical damage. Stuns for $$WILD_MAGIC_LIGHTNING_EFFECT.st
WILD_MAGIC.name: Wild Magic

WINDSHIELD.description:
Surround yourself with twisting winds, increasing your damage resistances by 0.2 for 10.

Whenever you take damage, release a gust of wind in a {2} radius around you, knocking back all enemies hit by {3}.
WINDSHIELD.name: Wind Shield

WINDWALL.description:
Create a {0} wide Wind Wall while channeling for {1}.
Purges all buffs (except healing over time effects) from all enemies.
Knocks back all enemies touching it by 8.75.
Grants you immunity to purges while channeling.
WINDWALL.name: Wind Wall
